t: You're at The Comedy Store, a comedy club in Soho. It opened in 1979, started by Don Ward and Peter Rosengard. Ward went on to run the place and is its chief executive. He performed as a variety act in the 1970s, though he's not really known as a comedian. In 2003 The Observer listed him among the fifty funniest acts in British comedy. Rosengard, who co-founded the club, was an insurance salesman. So this famous comedy room began with a businessman's idea rather than a stand-up's.
